recommendation: Keep the empty no-change audit commit. No FHIR-11254 follow-up is needed in core; FHIR-10473 was found only as background about timeline navigation and should be considered separately if that older navigation request is ever re-opened.
issue_request: FHIR-11254 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU2 technical correction for the FHIR-core timelines page asking whether the "D" had been dropped, specifically changing the abbreviation for "Standard for Trial Use" from DSTU to STU.
initial_application: The issue was applied by git-svn commit 6c80e582b40157500644ea667068c619ba121dcd, "#11254 - rename DSTU to STU", matching Jira's svn revision 10327 comment. That commit updated source/timelines.html in three places, including the exact sentence cited by the Jira issue.
additional_context: Commit d68b8964af6bcba886df7c89465a68e18951f5fd later reorganized the version-related documentation, leaving source/timelines.html absent from the current source and moving the relevant standards/versioning material into versions/history pages. Current source/versions.html uses Trial Use/STU for active standards-status wording, while remaining DSTU references are historical release labels or glossary entries. Current build.fhir.org returns 404 for timelines.html and serves the standards-status text from versions.html.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the requested wording was corrected historically and no obsolete current source sentence remains for FHIR-11254.

related_jiras.note: Surfaced in a broad DSTU/STU timelines Jira search, but it concerns a separate compatibility/timeline navigation request rather than the acronym wording corrected by FHIR-11254.
